
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /awake  (/caffeinate)                      │
  │  Stay-Awake Mode                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Toggle stay-awake mode (prevents macOS sleep).

  Usage:
    /awake
    /caffeinate

  Details:
    Uses macOS 'caffeinate' to prevent the system from sleeping.
    Useful during long-running tasks. Toggle off when done.

  Examples:
    $ /awake
    $ /caffeinate

  Related: /modes
